Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by AirPods Pro 3 dropping to the best price ever at the $169 Amazon all-time low ($80 off). This deal has been less than reliable, coming in and out of stock, but it appears to be up for grabs right now at the time of writing – get in there while you can. We also have polished titanium Apple Watch Series 11 models up to $160 off with Father’s Day delivery (plus more from $299), Apple’s official MagSafe Battery sitting at all-time low pricing (40% off), and Beats headphones up to $220 off at Best Buy. Head below for a closer look.

Now live again! AirPods Pro 3 just dropped to the best price ever at $169 Amazon all-time low (Reg. $249)

Amazon just dropped AirPods Pro 3 back down to the lowest price ever at $169 shipped – that’s $80 off and the best price to date.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 down at $169 shipped. Regularly $249, this is Amazon all-time low pricing at 32% off the list price to deliver a solid $80 in savings on arguably the best earbuds out there.

We caught this all-time low for a very brief time a couple days ago, but it jumped back up to $179 not more than 10 or 15 minutes later. This morning though, as the cutoff time to score Dad something amazing for Father’s Day draws nearer, and with this year’s Prime Day event quickly approaching, the best price ever at $169 is now up for grabs again. There’s no telling how long this deal might stick around for – get in there while you can.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $169 (Reg. $249) – All-time low now live again
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $499 (Reg. $549) – New all-time low

There was a chance Amazon might just stick to the $199 deal price on AirPods Pro 3 this year, but all of that went out the window when the previous $179 low went live in its Father’s Day offers, and now once again at a, frankly, incredible price for AirPods Pro 3 at $169

Previous to last week’s $179 low, we had never tracked AirPods Pro for less than $185 online, and even that deal was entirely short-lived and tough to get. That might be the case again here this week at $169, but the deal is now live and up for grabs for anyone right now.

Early Prime Day/Father’s Day Apple Watch deals: Rare $99 Ultra 3 price drop, more from $219

With the early Prime Day deals landing in full force and Father’s Day quickly approaching, we are kicking the week off with a look at the best Apple Watch deals now up for grabs. The latest Series 11 lineup is at least $100 off right now with deals starting from $299, while the even more affordable SE 3 deals roll on, and now we have a rare Apple Watch Ultra 3 deal at nearly $100 off to add into the mix.

Apple Watch Series 11 deals

The entry models are $100 off once again to match the lowest we have tracked on Amazon. Just be sure to keep an eye on that 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model that is now $130 off the list price as well:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $299 (Reg. $399) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $329 (Reg. $429) – All colors
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 Titanium $609 (Reg. $749)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Titanium $639 (Reg. $799)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Titanium $609 (Reg. $749)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 Slate Titanium $589 (Reg. $699)

Apple Watch SE 3 deals:

Pricing has gone up since last week on the SE 3 GPS + Cell models, but the least expensive variants are still down at the same rates with deal pricing starting from $219 – this delivers the lowest price of entry into Apple’s current-generation Apple Watch lineup:

  • 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 from $219 (Reg. $249)
  • 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 cell from $269 (Reg. $299)
  • 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 from $249 (Reg. $279)
  • 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 cell from $299 (Reg. $329)

Apple Watch Ultra 3 deals:

While the options in terms of bands is limited here, deals on Ultra 3 have been rare at best. We are now tracking a notable $99 price drop on the standard black model with the matching black Ocean Band though, marking a return to the best price of the year on one of the more universally appealing and accessible variants in the latest Ultra 3 lineup:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Brand $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)

There are also a number of configs in various brand sizes down at $749 Amazon lows, or $50 off, but we generally reccomend holding off until they land at $99 off if you can.

Apple Watch Series 11 polished titanium models up to $160 off with Father’s Day delivery

Is Dad an iPhone Air user? Apple’s official MagSafe Battery sitting at all-time low right now (40% off)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Beats headphones up to $220 off at Best Buy right now, buds from $50
  • Just $16 today gets you this compact 65W GaN charger with retractable USB-C cable (All-time low)
  • UGREEN’s latest FineTrack Mini 2 Find My trackers are down to just $8 each today with this 4-pack at 33% off
  • Rechargeable Find My wallet trackers don’t get much less than this, score UGREEN’s new FineTrack Slim for just $18 (All-time low)
  • Latest Beats 10-foot 240W braided USB-C cable starts from $19 (Nearly 40% off)
  • Sharge’s USB-C Pixel laptop chargers with up to 140W output and dot-matrix displays hit lowest prices today from just $42.50
  • Get Samsung’s 32-inch 4K HDR Smart monitor for your Mac workstation while it’s down to $230 Amazon low
  • These Matter smart plug 4-pack includes a remote, allowing you to power cycle your internet for $8.50 each
  • It’s hard to beat this LISEN Qi2.2 25W MagSafe car charger that undercuts the competition at just $21 (58% off)

Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 sitting down at Amazon all-time low pricing ahead of Father’s Day

While AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 or AirPods 4 at $99 make for a brilliant Dad’s day gift, if you’re looking to go big this year, or perhaps score Apple latest over-ears for yourself, the Amazon all-time low pricing on AirPods Max 2 is still rolling.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 down at $499 shipped – this is the lowest price they have ever sold for in brand new condition since release.

Regularly $549, you’re looking at a solid $50 in savings and Amazon all-time low pricing.

There was a time when Best Buy’s open-box deals presented a notable chance to save some cash on these things for early adopters, but the prices are hardly lower than Amazon’s ongoing all-time lows right now. At the time of writing Best Buy is charging full price for Max in brand new condition.

There is of course a chance we see them drop even lower for Prime Day next week, but that’s not going to be much good if you’re looking to land a set for Dad, and it’s hard to imagine them dropping all that much lower than this. Something like $479 isn’t out of the question but a full $100 off would be a wild price drop this soon after release on Apple’s flagship over-ears.

The first truly next-generation set of AirPods Max, the set we are featuring here today deliver up to “1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than original AirPods Max,” alongside enhanced adaptive audio and transparency modes, Conversation Awareness tech, Live Translation support, and more. Dive into our feature post and hands-on review for a complete rundown of what’s new this time around:

iPhone 17 Pro up to $290 off list prices via Amazon renewed right now

This morning we are circling back around to the deals that have started to pop recently on Amazon renewed iPhone 17 Pro units. It has taken a little bit longer this generation for Amazon to serve up notable discounts on Apple’s latest Pro-grade iPhone, but they are here and you can score up to $290 off the list price right now.

It is going to be a while before iPhone 17 Pro units appear in the official Apple refurb store, and even once they do Amazon tends to have much lower prices anyway. There are no 17 Pro units in the Apple refurb store yet, but you can land up to $290 off in Amazon renewed condition right now and a few off the Cosmic Orange and the 1TB Deep Blue model have now dropped even lower:

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,123 (Reg. $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,108 (Reg. $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,210 (Reg. $1,499)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,269 (Reg. $1,499)

As a quick reminder, you will want to make sure you are specifically looking at the units shipped and sold by/from Amazon. There are plenty of them on there from less than desirable sellers, and it can get confusing when Amazon auto switches the listing on you as you’re flipping through the colors and storage options. The links above should direct you to the best listings at the best prices.
